captions.caption: A man sits on the ground, sorting through small larvae on a green leaf.
The man continues to pick up larvae and place them in a pile on the leaf.
He carefully moves the larvae around on the leaf with his fingers.
The man reaches for a machete that is resting on the ground.
He picks up the machete while remaining in a squatting position.
The man uses the machete to scrape the soil near the leaf.
He continues to clear the area around the leaf with the machete.
The man uses the machete to make small cuts in the ground.
The man stands up after finishing his work with the machete.
The man walks towards a wooden structure in the background.
He picks up a long bamboo pole from a stack of wood.
The man examines the bamboo pole while standing in the clearing.
He prepares to cut the bamboo pole with his machete.
The man strikes the end of the bamboo pole with the machete.
He continues to chop at the bamboo pole to create an opening.
The man uses the machete to split the bamboo pole further.
He peels away a strip of bamboo from the pole with the machete.
The man continues to shape the end of the bamboo pole.
He strikes the bamboo pole again to refine the split section.
The man uses the machete to carve the interior of the bamboo pole.
He continues to work on the opening of the bamboo pole.
The man stands up, holding the processed bamboo pole and machete.
He moves towards the wooden structure with the bamboo pole.
The man leans the bamboo pole against the wooden structure.
The man uses the machete to trim the top of the bamboo pole.
The man continues to refine the bamboo pole with precise cuts.
He moves to the side to get a better angle for cutting.
The man uses the machete to remove another section of bamboo.
He continues to work on the bamboo pole, striking it with the machete.
The man carefully carves the bamboo pole to create a specific shape.
He uses the machete to peel off a thin layer of bamboo.
The man continues to refine the bamboo pole's opening.
The man picks up the bamboo pole and moves back to the leaf.
The man sets aside his tools and prepares the bamboo vessel.
A close-up shot shows a pile of larvae moving on a green leaf.
The camera remains focused on the larvae, showing their texture and movement.
The larvae are shown in detail as they crawl on the leaf.
The man's hands enter the frame and begin picking up the larvae.
The man sits on the ground and starts placing the larvae into the bamboo.
The man continues to transfer the larvae from the leaf to the bamboo.
He picks up a handful of larvae and stuffs them into the pole.
The man uses his fingers to push the larvae into the bamboo.
A close-up shows the man carefully packing larvae into the bamboo pole.
He continues to fill the bamboo pole with the remaining larvae.
The man uses his thumb to press the larvae into the opening.
He picks up more larvae from the leaf and adds them to the pole.
The man ensures all the larvae are inside the bamboo pole.
He pushes the last few larvae into the bamboo with his fingers.
The man picks up the green leaf and shakes it clean.
The man picks up the leaf and throws it away after emptying it.
The man taps the bamboo pole on the ground to pack the larvae.
He continues to tap the bamboo pole firmly against the earth.
The man taps the bamboo pole one last time before stopping.
He brings the bamboo pole to his mouth and begins to blow into it.
The man continues to blow into the end of the bamboo pole.
He takes a breath and then blows into the bamboo pole again.
The man blows steadily into the bamboo pole, creating a sound.
He continues to blow into the bamboo pole while sitting on the ground.
The man pauses briefly before blowing into the pole once more.
He finishes blowing into the bamboo pole and looks at it.
